extension.description: Generate and copy Arthas commands (watch/trace/stack/monitor/tt/ognl/vmtool/sc/sm/jad...) from the Java element under your cursor. Ported from arthas-idea-plugin.
cmd.vmtool.invoke: Arthas: Vmtool Get Instance Invoke Method Field
cmd.vmtool.setField: Arthas: Vmtool Get Instance Set Field
cmd.spring.getBeanSetField: Arthas: Spring Get Bean Set Field
cmd.ognl.static: Arthas: Ognl Invoke Static Method Field
cmd.springProps.vmtoolSelected: Arthas: Vmtool Get Selected Spring Property
cmd.springProps.vmtoolAll: Arthas: Vmtool Get All Spring Property
cmd.springProps.ognlSelected: Arthas: Ognl Get Selected Spring Property
cmd.springProps.ognlAll: Arthas: Ognl Get All Spring Property
cmd.sc: Arthas: Sc Search Class Loaded By Jvm
cmd.sm: Arthas: Sm Search Method Loaded By Jvm
menu.spring: Spring Get Context Invoke Method Field
config.monitorCount: Monitor count (-n) for the monitor command.
config.monitorInterval: Monitor cycle (--cycle, seconds) for the monitor command.
config.printConditionExpress: Append -v to print condition express result.
config.conditionExpressDisplay: Append default condition express '1==1' to generated commands.
config.traceSkipJdk: Skip JDK methods in trace. When false, appends --skipJDKMethod false.
config.staticSpringContextOgnl: Static spring context ognl expression, e.g. @com.demo.ApplicationContextProvider@context. Must NOT be the default value to enable the static spring context features.
config.autoToUnicode: Automatically convert Chinese characters in copied commands to \uXXXX unicode escapes.
config.showCopyNotification: Show the notification after copying a command (it also carries the Open doc / AOP variant buttons). Click "Don't show again" on the notification to turn it off.
